title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十六章、善良的孩子

    包拯在侍卫营见到了一个老兵。老兵告诉包拯，高小山二十多年前就死了。
    包拯一惊，问道：“他是怎么死的？和二十一年前冷宫的火灾有关吗？”
    “就是火灾那晚死的，别人说他是不小心从城墙上掉下来摔死的。”
    “别人说？真实情况不是这样吗？”
    “我见过他的尸体，胸口有刀伤，他是被人用刀杀死的，不是摔死的。”
    “谁杀了他？”
    “我不知道，当时宫里很乱，很多事情都不准问，也不准说。高小山只是个小兵，死就死了，没有人关心。”
    “死了一个人，也没有人关心吗？”包拯忍不住有些生气。
    老侍卫叹息着说：“别人说得没错，开封府的包大人真的是个好人。如果当时您在，高小山肯定不会死。”他向前走了一步，低声说道：“城东牛村有个叫王铁的，以前是侍卫营的，和高小山的关系很好。冷宫火灾后没多久，他家里老母亲生病了，他是独子，要回家照顾母亲，就离开侍卫营了。包大人，您去见见他，说不定他能帮上忙。”
    “多谢！”包拯感激地点头。
    老兵眼睛有点儿红，他说：“不用谢，我是为了小山，他是个善良的孩子，不应该死得不明不白。”
    “我明白，请放心。”包拯重重地点头。
    牛村在城东，出了宫骑马大概要一个多小时。包拯和公孙策都有点儿急，就在他们快步出宫门的时候，卫宁从后面跑过来叫住了他们。
    “卫大人，还有什么事吗？”包拯问。
    卫宁拿出一个东西：“包拯，这是皇上给你的令牌。有了这个令牌，你去哪儿都不会有人阻拦了。”
    “谢谢！”包拯感激地接过令牌。
    “皇上要你尽快把八王爷带回来，他说你可以命令侍卫营，有什么需要我做的，你随时跟我说。”
    “谢谢，我知道了。”包拯再次道谢，手里的令牌立刻变得沉重起来。
    牛村是个热闹的村子，包拯和公孙策在村口找人问了路，路人很热情：“王铁家就在村子那头，房子前面一大片菜地，你们往前走就可以看到。”他们按照指引，果然很容易就找到了前面有一大片菜地的房子。
    菜地里有个中年男人正弯着腰在地里种菜。
    “请问，你是王铁吗？”包拯问。
    中年男人直起身，回头笑着说：“我是王铁，你们是来买菜的吧？”
    “我叫包拯，这位是公孙策，我们不是来买菜的。”
fullText.traditional:
第十六章、善良的孩子

    包拯在侍衛營見到了一個老兵。老兵告訴包拯，高小山二十多年前就死了。
    包拯一驚，問道：“他是怎麼死的？和二十一年前冷宮的火災有關嗎？”
    “就是火災那晚死的，別人說他是不小心從城牆上掉下來摔死的。”
    “別人說？真實情況不是這樣嗎？”
    “我見過他的屍體，胸口有刀傷，他是被人用刀殺死的，不是摔死的。”
    “誰殺了他？”
    “我不知道，當時宮裡很亂，很多事情都不准問，也不准說。高小山只是個小兵，死就死了，沒有人關心。”
    “死了一個人，也沒有人關心嗎？”包拯忍不住有些生氣。
    老侍衛嘆息著說：“別人說得沒錯，開封府的包大人真的是個好人。如果當時您在，高小山肯定不會死。”他向前走了一步，低聲說道：“城東牛村有個叫王鐵的，以前是侍衛營的，和高小山的關係很好。冷宮火災後沒多久，他家裡老母親生病了，他是獨子，要回家照顧母親，就離開侍衛營了。包大人，您去見見他，說不定他能幫上忙。”
    “多謝！”包拯感激地點頭。
    老兵眼睛有點兒紅，他說：“不用謝，我是為了小山，他是個善良的孩子，不應該死得不明不白。”
    “我明白，請放心。”包拯重重地點頭。
    牛村在城東，出了宮騎馬大概要一個多小時。包拯和公孫策都有點兒急，就在他們快步出宮門的時候，衛寧從後面跑過來叫住了他們。
    “衛大人，還有什麼事嗎？”包拯問。
    衛寧拿出一個東西：“包拯，這是皇上給你的令牌。有了這個令牌，你去哪兒都不會有人阻攔了。”
    “謝謝！”包拯感激地接過令牌。
    “皇上要你盡快把八王爺帶回來，他說你可以命令侍衛營，有什麼需要我做的，你隨時跟我說。”
    “謝謝，我知道了。”包拯再次道謝，手裡的令牌立刻變得沉重起來。
    牛村是個熱鬧的村子，包拯和公孫策在村口找人問了路，路人很熱情：“王鐵家就在村子那頭，房子前面一大片菜地，你們往前走就可以看到。”他們按照指引，果然很容易就找到了前面有一大片菜地的房子。
    菜地裡有個中年男人正彎著腰在地裡種菜。
    “請問，你是王鐵嗎？”包拯問。
    中年男人直起身，回頭笑著說：“我是王鐵，你們是來買菜的吧？”
    “我叫包拯，這位是公孫策，我們不是來買菜的。”

sentences.pinyin: tā men àn zhào zhǐ yǐn guǒ rán hěn róng yì jiù zhǎo dào le qián miàn yǒu yí dà piàn cài dì de fáng zi
sentences.english: They followed the directions and easily found the house in front of a large field of vegetables.

sentences.simplified: 菜地里有个中年男人正弯着腰在地里种菜。
sentences.traditional: 菜地裡有個中年男人正彎著腰在地裡種菜。

sentences.english: In the field, a middle-aged man was bent over, planting vegetables.

sentences.simplified: “请问，你是王铁吗？”包拯问。
sentences.traditional: “請問，你是王鐵嗎？”包拯問。

sentences.english: “Excuse me, are you Wang Tie?” Bao Zheng asked.

sentences.simplified: “我是王铁，你们是来买菜的吧？”
sentences.traditional: “我是王鐵，你們是來買菜的吧？”

sentences.traditional: “我叫包拯，這位是公孫策，我們不是來買菜的。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiào bāo zhěng zhè wèi shì gōng sūn cè wǒ men bú shì lái mǎi cài de
sentences.english: “My name is Bao Zheng, and this is Gongsun Ce. We are not here to buy vegetables.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 16: A Kind-Hearted Kid
Bao Zheng met an old soldier in the imperial guard camp.
The old soldier told Bao Zheng that Gao Xiaoshan had died more than twenty years ago.
Bao Zheng was startled and asked, “How did he die? Is it related to the fire in the Cold Palace twenty-one years ago?”
“He died the night of the fire. Others say he accidentally fell from the city wall and died.”
“Others say? Were those not the real circumstances?”
“I saw his body. There was a knife wound in the pit of his stomach. He was killed by someone with a knife, not from a fall.”
“Who killed him?”
“I don’t know. The palace was in chaos at the time, and many things were not allowed to be asked or talked about.
Gao Xiaoshan was just an ordinary soldier. His death didn’t matter, and no one cared.”
“Someone died, and no one cared?” Bao Zheng couldn’t help but feel a bit angry.
The old guard sighed and said, “What others say is true. Lord Bao of Kaifeng Mansion really is a good man.
If you had been there at that time, Gao Xiaoshan definitely wouldn’t have died.”
He took a step forward and said softly, ..
.. “In Niu Village east of the city, there is a man named Wang Tie.
He used to be in the imperial guard camp, and he had a good relationship with Gao Xiaoshan.
Not long after the fire at the Cold Palace, his elderly mother fell ill at home.
As the only son, he had to go home to take care of his mother, so he left the imperial guard camp.
Lord Bao, you should go see him, maybe he can help.”
“Thank you very much!” Bao Zheng nodded gratefully.
The old soldier’s eyes were a bit red.
He said, “No need to thank me, I did it for Xiaoshan. He was a kind-hearted kid, and he didn’t deserve to die unjustly.”
“I understand, please rest assured.” Bao Zheng nodded firmly.
Niu Village was east of the city. It took a little over an hour to get there by horse from the palace.
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce were both in a hurry.
Just as they were quickly stepping out of the palace gate, Wei Ning ran up from behind and called out to them.
“Lord Wei, is there anything else?” Bao Zheng asked.
Wei Ning took out an item: “Bao Zheng, this is a token given to you by the emperor.
With this token, no one will stop you wherever you go.”
“Thank you!” Bao Zheng gratefully accepted the token.
“The emperor wants you to bring the Eighth Prince back as soon as possible.
He said you can command the imperial guard camp. If there’s anything you need from me, just let me know at any time.”
“Thank you, I understand.” Bao Zheng expressed his thanks again. The token in his hand immediately became heavy.
Niu Village was a bustling village.
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce asked for directions at the entrance of the village, and the passerby was very enthusiastic:
“Wang Tie’s house is just at the end of the village.
There’s a large field of vegetables in front of the house. If you walk straight ahead, you’ll see it.”
They followed the directions and easily found the house in front of a large field of vegetables.
In the field, a middle-aged man was bent over, planting vegetables.
“Excuse me, are you Wang Tie?” Bao Zheng asked.
The middle-aged man stood up straight, turned around, and smiled, saying, ..
.. “I am Wang Tie. You are here to buy vegetables, right?”
“My name is Bao Zheng, and this is Gongsun Ce. We are not here to buy vegetables.”
